registration: After learning and before either ablation is executed. Main direct/fixed test rows were already observed; evolving-arm test outcomes were not inspected when choosing these two fixed removal conditions. Exploratory mechanism attribution, not a fresh confirmation.
controls: Reuse completed, independently audited fixed compiled (neither skill) and evolving compiled (both skills) from the main study.
fixed: Same task cases, compiled executor, lossless reference view, readback criteria, actor 8 calls x 512 tokens, model and exact skill text; no further learning or checkpoint/prompt selection.
start_gate: Main full study summary complete, original resource counts restored, no owned active write journal.
claim_boundary: One learned skill pair and one seed, overlapping patients and reused main outputs. Generated skill rationales/examples are hypotheses, not validated clinical facts or execution receipts. This can attribute realized behavior to removal of a frozen artifact but cannot establish general RSI or clinical appropriateness.
